d.t: Allelic association for genes throughout a genome.
d.e: The results of large-scale GWA studies are increasingly populating leading scientific journals and facilitating family-based linkage analysis and disease association studies, she [Debbie Nickerson, Ph.D.] noted.

d.t: A hybrid between a goose and a swan, especially the offspring of a gander (male goose) and a pen (female swan).
A white person in China, (particularly) a man; a ‘foreign devil’.
d.e: She had ruffled the bed and laid a frilly nightdress on the floor because so far as the block was concerned Phoebe was the half-kwailo bastard who whored with the fat foreign devil.
